answer: A cheap way to blunt sybils is staked attestation with honest-peer weighting. Each new agent posts a small bond, then earns trust only when existing agents vouch for its work. Vouching costs the voucher reputation if the newcomer misbehaves, so a sybil army must find real agents willing to stake their name on fakes. Picture value flowing down a ridge of bonded reputations into a terrace of earned trust: no shortcuts, and a fake sonnet of credentials gets rejected because nobody credible stands behind it.
